java_locations.role: Builds a padded fixed-size merged label/note table for Graphviz placement, but later paints the center-label and note child blocks rather than that placeholder table.
Measures and paints the actual note component at its preferred dimensions.
Computes the final canvas from LimitFinder over primitives SvekEdge actually paints, not from Graphviz's invisible label placeholder.
Accumulates only drawing operations that reach the UGraphic.

rust_locations.role: Correctly distinguishes the padded merged Graphviz placeholder from the child origins used to paint the note and center label.
Incorrectly includes the complete padded placeholder rectangle in the painted envelope, adding unused right/bottom padding to the final canvas.

claimed_invariant: A Deployment link note and center label use one padded fixed-size compound block only as a Graphviz layout input. The painted envelope is the union of the actual note component rectangle and actual center-label text block at the child origins selected by the merge direction. Padding that exists solely around or between placeholder cells cannot expand SvekResult's LimitFinder canvas.
causal_divergence: Rust's deployment_edge_paint_bounds currently includes the full deployment_link_note_label_size rectangle from the solved label origin. For the preserved bottom-note probe, the Graphviz table is six pixels wider than the rightmost painted note primitive because its fixed cell contains unused padding and integer/fractional preferred-size slack. Java's LimitFinder never sees that placeholder, producing a 202px canvas; Rust counts it and produces 208px even though all emitted child geometry otherwise agrees.
planned_model_change: Compute a link-note painted-bounds rectangle from deployment_link_note_blocks, the note component's preferred painted dimensions, and the center label's emitted text dimensions. Feed that union to deployment_edge_paint_bounds while retaining deployment_link_note_label_size unchanged as Graphviz input. Add a unit test proving placeholder padding can exceed the painted maximum without changing child placement.
perturbation_axes: note position: top, bottom, left, and right
center label: absent, short, long, and multiline
note body: short, multiline, fractional preferred width, and explicit color/style
ownership: root links, nested-to-root links, and cluster-adjacent links
link direction: forward, reversed, and undecorated
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns only painted-envelope measurement of Deployment link-note/center-label compounds after Graphviz solves their origin. It does not own Graphviz placeholder dimensions, node or edge ordering, routes, coordinate serialization, link IDs, endpoint-label collision, parser identity, container placement, comparator slack, baselines, park lists, error markers, or guard allow-lists.
acceptance: The preserved slash-container link-note probe has Java's 202px canvas without changing any child path or text coordinates.
A model test distinguishes the padded Graphviz placeholder from the actual painted maximum.
Inputs with no link note or with ordinary center labels remain unchanged.
Renderer and no-oracle family metrics show no new failures.
A separate checker generates fresh valid link-note compounds over at least two independent axes and records a verdict.
forbidden_approaches: subtracting six pixels or keying behavior to the preserved fixture
changing Graphviz layout size to force the final canvas
rounding or translating emitted SVG strings after rendering
changing parser identity, link IDs, routes, or comparator controls
